bio.text: Michael Carter is a Democrat who represents District 36 (Adams and Arapahoe counties) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where he took office on January 8, 2025; Ballotpedia lists him as running for re-election in 2026.

Ballotpedia says Carter was born in Austin, Texas, served in the U.S. Army from 1990 to 1994, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Mexico in 2003 and a J.D. from the University of Denver in 2007.

It lists his career as attorney and small business owner, including service as a Colorado deputy public defender from May 2006 to August 2009, and his earlier service on the Aurora Public Schools Board of Education from 2021 to 2025.
